title: The Price of a Pun
text:
Few challenges test a translator's ingenuity as persistently as wordplay. A pun that delights readers in the source language often dissolves into nonsense when rendered literally, so the translator must find an equivalent joke rather than an equivalent word. The result may diverge considerably from the original, yet a faithful translation of humour is frequently one that provokes the same reaction.

Some critics argue that such liberties constitute a betrayal of the author's intent. Others counter that the translator's task is to recreate the effect on the reader, not the surface of the sentence. Consequently, the translations most admired by specialists are often those that openly acknowledge the impossibility of perfect transfer and compensate for it elsewhere in the text.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what must a translator find when a pun does not survive literal translation?
options: An equivalent joke rather than an equivalent word
A footnote that explains the original pun
A synonym for every word in the sentence
A new author who writes in the target language

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some critics argue about such liberties?
options: They constitute a betrayal of the author's intent
They improve the original text for modern readers
They are required by all publishers
They have no effect on the reader

questions.text: What does the passage imply about the translations that specialists admire most?
options: They compensate for losses in one part of the text with gains elsewhere
They copy the original sentence structure exactly
They avoid all wordplay in order to stay safe
They are shorter than the original text

questions.text: Why might a translation that changes a pun still be considered faithful?
options: Because it can produce the same reaction in the reader
Because it uses the exact same words as the original
Because the author approved every change in advance
Because it avoids any humour at all

vocabulary.definition: skill in finding clever solutions to difficult problems
loses its form or meaning, often figuratively
equal in value, meaning, or effect
freedoms taken with the original, such as changes to the text

paragraph_translations: Небагато викликів так наполегливо випробовують винахідливість перекладача, як гра слів. Каламбур, який тішить читача мовою оригіналу, часто перетворюється на безглуздя під час буквального перекладу, тож перекладач мусить знайти еквівалентний жарт, а не еквівалентне слово. Результат може значно відрізнятися від оригіналу, проте вірний переклад гумору часто той, що викликає ту саму реакцію.

Деякі критики стверджують, що такі вільності становлять зраду авторського задуму. Інші заперечують, що завдання перекладача — відтворити враження на читача, а не поверхню речення. Тому переклади, найвище цінені фахівцями, часто саме ті, що відверто визнають неможливість досконалої передачі та компенсують її в інших місцях тексту.
